Passive.description: Continuous background radio-frequency noise floor sweeping within target areas.

Active.description: Intentional wireless de-authentication injection packet targeted at an adversarial or unverified IoT device.

Dynamic.description: Real-time fluctuation of target signal strength used by tactical teams for proximity triangulation.

Location.description: Direction-finding compass telemetry tracking the relative angle of the incoming radio source.

Equipment.description: Firmware version and technical identifier of the Software Defined Radio board assembly.

Status.description: Current state machine flag defining device mode (Scanning, Rogue Cell Emulation, Idle).

User.description: Tactical badge identifier of the tactical team officer deploying the mobile equipment.

Operational.description: Telemetry monitoring remaining run-time in minutes for the mobile field deployment battery unit.

Service.description: Local AI inference classification tagging the intercepted device architecture (e.g., Hidden Camera).

RFID.description: Inventory tracking RFID chip scanned during tactical armory checkout procedures.

Historical.description: Historical database of previously captured IMSI/IMEI/MAC identities detected within this specific sector.

Spectrum.description: Comprehensive matrix of radio bands being concurrently monitored by the receiver path.

Environmental.description: Active cooling fan RPM tracking thermal dissipation based on environmental field exposure.
